# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — seed: 6 real+safe+verified fixes across all 4 skills (pivot tool, docx filler, pdf multi-page, pptx centering, python3, inspect-once)
- Changes I made (1 line per edit; file/tool + cluster):
  1. NEW `xlsx/pivot.py` + `xlsx/SKILL.md` "Creating PivotTables" — sales-pivot-analysis (real native PivotTable parts, not a faked groupby).
  2. `pptx/ooxml.md` "Positioning and centering a shape" + `pptx/SKILL.md` pointer — pptx-reference-formatting (algn="ctr" per paragraph AND real `<p:sldSz>` width, not hardcoded 9144000).
  3. NEW `docx/fill_template.py` + `docx/SKILL.md` conditional-recipe fix — offer-letter-generator (fill inner placeholders of kept blocks; gate by RELOCATION_PACKAGE not RELOCATION; multi-paragraph; verify no leftovers).
  4. `pdf/SKILL.md` "Advanced Table Extraction" rewrite — pdf-excel-diff (header once, keep all continuation-page rows; stop stripping `table[1:]` per page).
  5. `xlsx/SKILL.md` "Inspect the workbook ONCE" rule + one-shot dump snippet — weighted-gdp-calc (budget starvation from repeated structure dumps).
  6. `python`→`python3` on every script invocation in `xlsx/SKILL.md` + `pptx/SKILL.md` — gdp/reserves/pptx (runtime has no `python` binary; hit 7/15 trials).
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - pivot.py: flips sales-pivot (grader reads the pivot part that a groupby lacks). Safe: new file, only used on pivot tasks; exceltable-in-ppt never asks for a pivot.
  - pptx centering: flips pptx-reference-formatting. Safe: additive reference text; existing shape/format examples unchanged.
  - fill_template.py: stabilizes offer-letter flakiness (both bug classes fixed + verified on Yes/No cases). Safe: new file; SKILL.md edits are additive/annotative.
  - pdf recipe: flips pdf-excel-diff (recovers the dropped continuation-page rows; verified E4 retained vs old recipe dropping it). Safe: pdf skill unused by the only solid task (exceltable-in-ppt), zero blast radius.
  - inspect-once: reclaims budget for gdp t0 (which never saved). Safe: additive prose; changes no API behavior.
  - python3: corrects commands that currently fail everywhere (`python` absent). Safe: a passing task cannot depend on a spelling that errors; can only reduce wasted turns.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — this is the seed; RUNMAP/LEDGER/prior_iterations all empty.
- Refuted hypotheses: none proven yet. NOTE for next iter: the tempting shared "formulas-vs-hardcoded/recalc" root cause does NOT explain reserves/gdp — their failures are budget/env + task-specific compute (per diagnosis). Don't chase a global recalc rule for them.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: reserves-at-risk-calc (task-specific compute + flaky 403 IMF download), financial-modeling-qa (bespoke PDF dice scoring, deterministic wrong answer 24), invoice-fraud-detection (task-logic interpretation of missing/PO-INVALID → null; a safe generalizable skill edit likely won't flip it), xlsx-recover-data (benchmark ground-truth defect — unwinnable). All deliberately skipped to avoid overfitting; see PROCESS.md.
- Plateau signal: n/a (seed / first iteration).
- Focus next iteration: read this iteration's RESULT line. If pivot.py / fill_template.py / pdf-recipe accepted, PRESERVE them. If pptx-center or inspect-once did NOT move their task, consider promoting the behavioral prose to a bundled pptx-centering helper / a one-shot xlsx inspect+write scaffold script (code > prose for the sonnet-4-5 reader). Do NOT re-touch the skipped clusters unless a new non-overfitting lever appears.
